data.title: How Nvidia's $500B financing deal will entrench its AI dominance
data.description: Nvidia has partnered with six of the world’s largest asset managers to source more than $500 billion in third-party financing for AI infrastructure. The Wall Street heavyweights involved include Apollo, Blackstone, Brookfield, BlackRock, KKR and Goldman Sachs. CNBC’s Arjun Kharpal joins 'Squawk Box Europe' to discuss what the funding push could mean for Nvidia’s dominance in AI, the global rollout of data centers and growing concerns around circular financing.
